description: Plan task U13. handoff.text: REJECT on data safety (brief rule: approve only with no path to text loss). Pane-to-pane core is SOUND and verified: tsc 0; vitest split+save-queue 47/47; own build ui2-u13-review/dist port 1563: split-view x5 10/10 (no pageerror, so no ResizeObserver loop), editor-toolbar+footnotes+comments+research 25/25; reviewer probe ui2-u13-review/probe/split-safety.spec.mjs P1 (25 rapid alternations left/right, revisions strictly increasing on every write, both texts exact after Saved and reload, no cross text), P2 (type then remount via Cmd+click replace and Close right pane: all text kept), P3 (no entry ever in both panes) 9/9 over repeat-each 3. Screenshots light/dark viewed, fine. BUT the second live editor U13 introduces is not covered by the existing one-editor guards, and this tree loses saved writing on two reachable paths (probe log ui2-u13-review/probe2.log, both fail reproducibly; each first asserts the text WAS saved, then lost): (P4) fragment open in the right pane, focus left, open Fragments panel: the fragment card is still editable because App.tsx:2475 activeId={item?.id} (FragmentLibrary.tsx:168 editable = current && !active && open) -> type in the card (saved), then type in the right pane -> stored fragment = 'Frag base text PANE EDIT', the card edit is gone (Writer never re-syncs from props, Writer.tsx:412/494). (P5) fragment focused right, its footer Append to section -> One (open on the left): App.tsx:988 only uses the editor when target === active (focused pane), so it writes One's content directly (:1013-1030, saved), then raw setActive(target) at :1036 breaks the U13 invariant active===activeOf(split) (crumb One, focused pane right); typing in the left pane then overwrites One -> 'Section start more', appended fragment lost. Same class: FragmentLibrary Append (onAppend, open=false) into the unfocused pane's section. The worker disclosed these under REMAINS FOR U14 and the plan assigns them to U14 steps 3-5; fix = U14 steps 3-4 (editorFor(target) in appendFragment, activeIds for FragmentLibrary) or the plan default (close the split before such an operation). The coordinator may re-scope and approve over this reject if U14 lands before any build; everything else in U13 is approvable as is. Minor non-blocking: left pane undo/scroll reset on split open/close (disclosed); deleting a pane's entry leaves a stale split until reload (U14 prune), and if the LEFT entry is deleted Cmd+click silently does nothing because openBeside reuses split.left.

DESIGN DOC: Split view -- two panes side by side in the writing area; one formatting bar above both acts on the focused pane (the focused pane's own bar is moved into a shared slot). The divider is a 6 px hit area showing a 1 px line, accent on hover and keyboard focus, arrow keys move it 2 percent; the width ratio is global (personal-word.splitRatio, 25-75 percent), the pane layout is per project (personal-word.split.projectId). The right pane has a quiet header (entry title, muted until focused) at control height with a Close right pane button. Square corners, no shadows, no animation.

FIXES: (P4) src/organization/FragmentLibrary.tsx:17,29,98 prop activeIds?: string[] replaces activeId; a card is read-only with the note 'Open in the main editor. Cmd+click then opens beside the survivor.
